sloka: वर्तते दशमो मासो द्वौ तु शेषौ प्लवङ्गम ।रावणेन नृशंसेन समयो यः कृतो मम ।। ५.३७.८।।।।
transliteration: vartate daśamo māso dvau tu śeṣau plavaṅgama ।rāvaṇena nṛśaṁsena samayo yaḥ kṛto mama ।। 5.37.8।।।।

translations.english: "O vanara this is the end of the tenth month. Only two more months are left. This is the condition laid by the wicked Ravana in my case.
